en: Holy Threads
Acquire Dawnwoven Fabrics by weaving cloth into bolts while in close proximity to the Crusader's Loom. Return to Taylor once you have enough.

This loom is special. Did you know that? All of our craftsmen had their tools of the trade blessed by our high priests.

In particular, the loom attracts stray fabrics and thread destined to be used in the holiest of our ceremonial vestaments. Over time, we will have enough gathered to create a new robe, and these days are a cause for celebration, for me at least.

If you are interested in the process for your own curiosity, thread some bolts near the loom and watch the Light at work.
Ancient Allies
Travel west from the hermit's cave to find an outpost of ancients and dryads on the lower slopes of Mount Hyjal.

$n, I have little more to offer. If you mean to make the long trek up the mountain, you might do well to speak with some of its ancient caretakers.

Follow the road to the west. Look north, toward the foot of the mountain. You will eventually see an outpost, a remnant of the guardians that once roamed the slopes. There is an ancient there named Fraxinus. He and his friends can assist you.
The Staff of the Mountain
Bring the Staff of the Mountain to Tiala Whitemane at the Summit of Eternity.

With all of the ingredients you assembled I was able infuse the staff you recovered with a new magic. You should now be able to bring this to bear to counteract the magic of the Wild Gods that Ve'han has so brazenly stolen.

We will need to test it, however. Bring this to the druid known as Tiala Whitemane at the Summit of Eternity. She may be able to help.
Disturbed Grave
Search the area for the grave's missing contents.

<Someone, or something, has rummaged through the dirt, leaving fragments of bone scattered about. An oddly shaped indentation leads deeper into the cold, wet dirt.

Something within the area may have caused the disruption.>
More Work?
Speak with the peasant to let him know the job's done.

Battles are often long and hard fought, led by those willing to stand against an imminent threat and look death in the face.

The truth is, many sacrifices were made, not just on the battlefield. We often overlook those who do their part to contribute.

Just yonder is a peasant by the name of... well come to think of it, I don't even know his name. What kind of person am I? He's kept us well-tended and nourished throughout our stay.

Could you speak with him? Let him know the job's done.
Scalebeard
Retrieve the Prismatic Shell for Archmage Xylem.  The Archmage resides in a tower atop the cliffs of Azshara.

There isn't much time, $n!  My scrying spells have revealed a powerful source of magic.  I cannot leave the tower, and would ask you to kill the vile creature in possession of this artifact.$b$bThe beast is known as Scalebeard, hiding in a cave among the Bay of Storms. Burn him to ashes and take the prismatic shell from his den.
Pay Dirt!
Find someone to appraise the Humongous Crystal.

<The large hunk of crystal is even heavier than it looks. While it appears to be quite the prize, its true nature is unknown to you. Someone with knowledge in geology could say what you've really found.>
Leather for Inclement Weather
Bring $1oa Rugged Armor Kits and $2oa Cured Rugged Hide to Zet'gan in Elderwild on Mount Hyjal.

Livin' out in da wild for five years done take a toll on our supplies. We had to make dis place from scratch! We could use your skills as a leatherworker.

I need to repair some of da tents and buildings, and patch up some armor. You bring me a pair of Rugged Armor Kits and a Cured Rugged Hide, I help you turn it into something special.
Eyes of the Watchers
Retrieve $1oa Watcher's Eyes for Eluneth.

Just north of here lies the ruins of battles past. A dwindling scourge presence remains.

Though the mindless undead are a threat themselves, the watchers maintain a vigilant eye on those entering the area, making removal of the scourge threat even more difficult.

Remove the threat by taking from these watchers that which they value most.
Rediscovering the Light
Heal $1oa Injured Deathguard with your Holy Light ability.

I am proud to welcome another newly risen paladin to our ranks. As you begin to reconnect with the light you may notice that certain abilities that were once second nature to you may cause you considerable pain to use now, particularly those involving channeling the light to heal yourself or others. 

The only way around this problem is--unfortunately--to go through it. Like any other muscle that has atrophied, you must push through the pain and exercise the flesh for it to return to full function.
Mastery of the light will return, in time.

Pain is nothing new to those who have endured death, and as such the Forsaken are particularly hardy to it. Pain has a purifying property as well that you should embrace as a badge of honor and evidence that you are, in fact, still a servant of the light despite your new circumstances. 

Be well and walk in the light once more, $c.
